dossier.body:
# About you

You are coming back from a stress reaction in your left shin after ten weeks off. Your physio cleared you to start walk-run in early September, three days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Saturday), with a rule of stopping if the shin aches during a run. Before the injury you ran 40 km a week. You want to run 30 minutes without walking by mid-October. You do the physio's calf and hip exercises twice a week.
